name: thermowatch-monorepo
description: ThermoWatch — SIH26162 (NTRO). client/: React console · server/api: FastAPI brain · server/ingest: Bun FIRMS worker. Each package manages its own deps (npm for client, bun for ingest).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && cd server/api && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../ingest && bun install
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:client && npm run test:claims && npm run test:scenesurface
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && cd server/ingest && bun run typecheck
